pages.text: Place connected lattice beside a flower root, or click plain lattice with grapes.

pages.title: Live & Decorative
pages.text: New vines grow along nearby connected plain lattices. Bonemeal helps. Crop lattices placed as items retain their pictured stage as decoration. For a farm, spread onto plain lattice from a live root or grapes.

pages.title: Harvest Intact
pages.text: Use shears on fully grown live lattice crops for three or four items. Grapes reset to stage one and morning glory to stage two, leaving the lattice in place.
